description_en:
The OAuth2 token endpoint currently supports the following two operations:  
Obtain an access_token by using an authorization code.  
Refresh an access_token by using a refresh token.
description_zh:
OAuth2令牌端点，目前支持以下两种操作：
通过code获取access_token。
通过refresh_token刷新access_token
name: OAuth2TokenEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
Grant type, required.  
authorization_code: Use an authorization code to obtain an access token.  
refresh_token: Refresh an access token.
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型，必填。
authorization_code: 用授权码来获取访问令牌
refresh_token: 刷新访问令牌
parameters.name: grant_type

parameters.help_en: Authorization code. It is required when exchanging an authorization code for an access token
parameters.help_zh: 授权码，通过授权码换取访问令牌时必填
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en: Redirection URI. This value must exactly match the parameter value you provided in the initial authorization request. Required when exchanging an authorization code for an access token
parameters.help_zh: 重定向地址，该值必须与您发起授权请求的参数值完全一致。通过授权码换取访问令牌时必填
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.help_en: Refresh token, required when refreshing an access token.
parameters.help_zh: 刷新令牌，刷新访问令牌时必填
parameters.name: refresh_token

AccessToken.description_en: The token issued by Tmall Genie to your application.
AccessToken.description_zh: 天猫精灵给您的应用颁发的令牌
AccessToken.title_zh: 天猫精灵给您的应用颁发的令牌。

ExpiresIn.description_en: The remaining lifecycle of the access token, in seconds.
ExpiresIn.description_zh: 访问令牌的剩余生命周期（以秒为单位）
ExpiresIn.title_zh: 访问令牌的剩余生命周期（以秒为单位）。

RefreshToken.description_en: A token that can be used to obtain a new access token.
RefreshToken.description_zh: 可用于获取新访问令牌的令牌
RefreshToken.title_zh: 可用于获取新访问令牌的令牌。

Scope.description_en: The permission scope granted by the access_token, represented as a space-separated list of case-sensitive strings.
Scope.description_zh: access_token 授予的访问权限范围，表示为以空格分隔、区分大小写的字符串列表
Scope.title_zh: access_token 授予的访问权限范围，表示为以空格分隔、区分大小写的字符串列表。

TokenType.description_en: The type of the returned token. Currently, the value of this field is always set to Bearer.
TokenType.description_zh: 返回的令牌的类型。此时，此字段的值始终设置为 Bearer
TokenType.title_zh: 返回的令牌的类型。此时，此字段的值始终设置为 Bearer。
